name: Thoppur Ghat S-Curve
danger_type: Steep downhill descent & blind dual S-curve prone to brake failure and rear-end pileups
recommendation: Shift to lower gear (2nd/3rd), maintain 40 km/h speed limit, do not overtake on curve, engine braking mandatory.
nearest_hospital: Dharmapuri Govt Medical College Hospital (18 km)

name: Kalhatty Hairpin Bends (Bend 1 to 36)
danger_type: Extreme 36 hairpin gradient (up to 18% incline), brake fluid overheating and rollback cliff drop
recommendation: Restricted for descending non-local vehicles. Use 1st/2nd gear only. Do not ride the brakes. Stop at cooling bays.

name: Burliar to Marappalam Ghat Stretch
danger_type: Monsoon mudslides, heavy fog/blind corners, tourist vehicle head-on collisions during blind overtakes
recommendation: Turn on fog lamps, sound horn at blind curves, strictly avoid overtaking heavy buses on bends.

name: Vadaputhupatti Intersection
danger_type: High-speed cross-median intersection near Ambur with un-signalized industrial traffic
recommendation: Slow down to 50 km/h, watch for slow-moving agricultural and freight vehicles crossing median cuts.

name: Sankari Bypass Median Merge
danger_type: High-velocity container trucks switching lanes, poorly lit service lane merges
recommendation: Stay in middle lane, avoid speeding over 80 km/h at night, look out for merging trucks.
nearest_hospital: Salem Government Mohan Kumaramangalam Hospital (32 km)

name: Walajapet Toll & Kaveripakkam Curve
danger_type: Sudden queuing of multi-axle trailers before toll plaza, night driver fatigue zone
recommendation: Keep safe 3-second distance behind trucks, take tea break if driving between 2 AM and 5 AM.

name: Paranur - Chengalpattu Flyover Junction
danger_type: Extreme commuter traffic during peak hours, sudden speed reductions after toll
recommendation: Follow lane discipline, watch for two-wheelers on the left shoulder.

name: Sunguvarchatram Industrial Corridor
danger_type: Late night factory bus movement, pedestrian crossings near industrial estates
recommendation: Watch for sudden pedestrian crossings, keep headlights on low beam in traffic.

name: Avinashi Bypass - Tiruppur Junction
danger_type: Speed violations on long straightaway, sudden turning at unsanctioned U-turns
recommendation: Do not exceed 90 km/h, beware of vehicles making illegal U-turns across breaks in median.

name: Mettupalayam Foothill Ascent (Ghat Entry)
danger_type: Narrow river bridge, transition to winding mountain incline, slow tourist buses
recommendation: Check tire pressure and coolant level before climbing ghats. Give way to descending vehicles.

name: Perundurai Chithode Bypass
danger_type: T-junction crossover, high-speed textile freight traffic
recommendation: Reduce speed at Chithode flyover divergence, stay vigilant during early dawn hours.
nearest_hospital: IRT Perundurai Medical College Hospital (6 km)

name: Maduravoyal Grade Separator & Vanagaram
danger_type: Heavy city bus and two-wheeler congestion, elevated bypass flyover ramp merge
recommendation: Maintain safe stopping distance, follow navigation lane assist carefully.
